attributes.board_name: State of Ohio Board of Pharmacy

rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE courses designated for pharmacist credit (P or PT); in-state Board-approved providers only for jurisprudence and volunteer health care services; IPCE credits accepted. CME and CLE are not accepted. Any format (live or home study)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Pharmacists renewing for the first time (initial licensure by exam or reciprocity) need not earn or report CE.
rules.alternatives: Current Board-approved specialty certification (BPS, SPCB, CSPI) replaces the general hours, but 2 h law and 2 h patient safety still required. Volunteer health care services may cover up to one-third (10 h). Exempt if licensed and CE-compliant in another mandatory-CE state and not practicing in Ohio for the two years before renewal.
rules.audit_note: All ACPE credits must be reported to NABP CPE Monitor; attest at renewal. Keep non-ACPE certificates one year after the renewal year; documents due within 30 days of a Board request; Board audits licensees.

topics.who: Pharmacy jurisprudence/law (ACPE topic 03) or Board-approved in-state jurisprudence

rules.notes: Pharmacist licenses moved to a biennial cycle: all renewed licenses expire Sept 15, 2027; CE for 2027 earned Sept 16, 2025 - Sept 15, 2027. Topic hours count only with the ACPE topic designator. Late fee after Sept 15.
